title: Contractual per-data-class recovery objectives
objective: Commit recovery objectives per data class and capability, derived from the BIA, and reference them in every tenant contract.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Fenced single authoritative writer with quorum durability
objective: Acknowledge authoritative financial commits only after quorum-durable replication and allow exactly one fenced writer, so failover cannot lose acknowledged commits or create split brain.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)
residual_risks: RPO zero holds only under the stated fault assumptions; a correlated loss of a quorum can still lose acknowledged commits.

title: Scheduled recovery exercises with measured objectives
objective: Exercise failover and restore for every data class at least annually per isolation profile and compare measured results to objectives.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Fault-injection suite at transactional boundaries
objective: Inject crashes, stale replicas, provider timeouts and webhook replays at each transactional boundary in a production-like environment and assert no lost or duplicated financial effects.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Generated recovery dependency map
objective: Generate the recovery dependency graph from infrastructure definitions so it cannot drift from the deployed system.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Rebuild from source into a clean account
objective: Ensure the full environment can be recreated from version-controlled source, infrastructure definitions and Strata schema in a new, uncompromised account.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)
notes: Strata is pilot status and supports PostgreSQL 16 only (ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).

title: Tenant-scoped restore tooling
objective: Restore one tenant to a point in time through tooling bound to a single verified tenant context, with negative isolation tests on the result.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Payment release lock after restore
objective: Keep payment release disabled after any restore until C0 consistency and external provider reconciliation pass and independent authorization lifts the lock; replay protective holds and cancellations first.

title: Disaster declaration authority and notification procedure
objective: Define who may declare a disaster, notification timelines and channels, and complementary customer actions.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)
